notes: Empyrion Digital (Singapore) held grand opening of KR1 Gangnam Data Center at Yangjae-dong 224, Seocho-gu (branded 'Gangnam' for the commercial district) on 2 Jul 2025; 37,714 sqm, Tier 3, 40 MW design / 29.4 MW IT load, first new data center in the Gangnam area in over a decade. Located in Seocho-gu despite the Gangnam brand.
